usedFor: Fathom records meetings, and each “New Action Item” becomes a row in Microsoft Excel.

bestTemplate.name: “New Action Item” in Fathom, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Every action item from a meeting is logged as a table row, so follow-ups sit in one sheet.

watchOut: “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel adds to a table, so set up one with matching columns first.
